result.topic_en: Integration of the hyperbolic equation $\partial^2u/\partial p\partial q + u = 0$ (with $p=t+x$, $q=t-x$) by contour integrals and by a Riemann-function (characteristic) method using $\omega=\sum(-1)^n (p-p')^n(q-q')^n/(\Pi n\,\Pi n)$, dated June 1856.
result.transcription:
Integration der Gleichung $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p\partial q}+u=0$, $p=t+x$ $q=t-x$, $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2}=\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}-4u$. \quad Juni 1856.
$u=\int \cos 2\sigma \frac{xt}{t^2-\sigma^2}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\sqrt{t^2-x^2-\sigma^2}}$ \quad $(-t \quad -\sqrt{pq} \quad \sqrt{pq} \quad +t)$ \quad $p>0$ $q>0$
$u=\frac12\varphi' t$
$q=+0$ $p>0$. $u=-2\pi+2\pi\cos 2t$
$q>0$ $p=+0$ $u=2\pi-2\pi\cos 2t$
$q<0$ $p>0$ $u=2\pi\cos 2t$
$p<0$ $q>0$ $u=-2\pi\cos 2t$
$u=\int \sin 2\sigma \frac{\sigma [-x-]}{t^2-\sigma^2}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\sqrt{t^2-x^2-\sigma^2}}$ \quad $(-t \quad -\sqrt{pq} \quad \sqrt{pq} \quad +t)$ \quad $p>0$ $q>0$.
$u=\varphi(t)$
$q<0$ $p>0$ $u=2\pi\sin 2t$
$q>0$ $p<0$ $u=-2\pi\sin 2t$
$u=\int \sin 2\sigma\, [-\sigma\partial\sigma-] (t^2-x^2-\sigma^2)^{-\frac32}$ \quad $(-\sqrt{pq} \cdot \sqrt{pq})$ \quad $u=\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x}$ $p>0$ $q>0$
$q=+0$ $p>0$ \\ $q>0$ $p=+0$ $\} u=-2\pi$ \quad $u=-2\pi\sum(-1)^n\frac{p^n q^n}{\Pi n\,\Pi n}$
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p\partial q}+u=0$. $\frac{\partial^2 u'}{\partial p\partial q}+u'=0$. $\int(\frac{\partial u'}{\partial p}u\,dp+\frac{\partial u}{\partial q}u'\,dq)=-\int\frac{\partial u}{\partial p}u'\,dp+\frac{\partial u'}{\partial q}u\,dq+\int du\,u'=0$ \quad $(\circlearrowright)$
$\omega=\sum(-1)^n\frac{(p-p')^n(q-q')^n}{\Pi n\,\Pi n}$ \quad [Figur: $p=p'$, $q=q'$, $s$]
$\int\frac{\partial\omega}{\partial p}u\,dp+\frac{\partial u}{\partial q}\omega\,dq$
$\int_{s,q'}^{s,p'}+\int_{s,p'}^{p',q'}+\int_{p',q'}^{s,q'}=0$ \quad $\int_{s,q'}^{s,p'}-u_{s,p'}+u'=0$
$u'=u_{s,p'}-\int_{s,q'}^{s,p'}\frac{\partial\omega}{\partial p}u\,dp+\frac{\partial u}{\partial q}\omega\,dq$
$\frac{\partial u'}{\partial q'}=-\int_{s,q'}^{s,p'}\omega u\,dp+\frac{\partial u}{\partial q}\frac{\partial\omega}{\partial q}\partial q+\frac{\partial u}{\partial q}\Big/_{s,q'}$
$\frac{\partial^2 u'}{\partial p'\partial q'}=+\int_{s,q'}^{s,p'}\frac{\partial\omega}{\partial p}u\,dp+\frac{\partial u}{\partial q}\omega\,\partial q-u_{s,p'}$
